values.note: Herrick nightly camping fee $40 for county residents and non-residents alike (14-night maximum); cabins $60. Extended stays booked Dec 1 - Feb 1 only: 30 consecutive nights $750 resident / $875 non-county, full season (May to end of September) $2,300 / $2,800. $5 processing fee per campsite reserved. A vehicle entrance permit is included with a camping reservation (extra vehicles $6/day).

fees.source: https://www.isabellacounty.org/departments/parks-recreation/reservations/fees-charges/ ('Nightly Camping Fee – Herrick Recreation Area (14-night maximum) $40.00 $40.00', 'Processing Fee ... $5.00') + https://www.isabellacounty.org/departments/parks-recreation/policies/camping-policies/ ('A park entrance permit for your vehicle is included with your camping reservation'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online through Isabella County's GoingToCamp site; payment due at booking. 14 consecutive nights at most (adopted 2026-08-05), then 5 nights away; 30+ night and full-season stays can be booked only Dec 1 - Feb 1. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.isabellacounty.org/departments/parks-recreation/policies/camping-policies/ ('Coldwater Lake Family Park and Herrick Recreation Area require a minimum two (2) night stay, except holidays, which require a minimum three (3) night stay', 'a park user may not camp for more than 14 consecutive nights in Herrick Recreation Area's campground') + onlinereservations page (link to isabellacounty.goingtocamp.com), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Modern ADA bathhouse (opened with a ribbon cutting 2026-05-27); vault toilets on the campground side.

note: Isabella County park, 113 acres at 6320 E Herrick Rd, Clare: campsites plus 5 rustic cabins overlooking three fishing ponds, sandy swimming beach, 2 pavilions. Water comes from community spigots near the sites; campers cannot stay hooked up. Hammock posts at sites 34-42. --Claude
summary: County pages read: $40 a night for everyone (non-resident = resident), $5 processing fee, entrance permit included; reservable online on Isabella County's GoingToCamp (was 'phone'), standing 2-night minimum (3 on holidays), 14-night max; season Apr 30 - Sep 30 (2027 stated); 20/30-amp electric, no site water (community spigots), 73 sites, dump/vault toilets. Note cleaned: dropped the wrong 'Season ~May-early Oct' and 'seasonal reservations by phone' and the hookup/site-count text. Extended (30-night/full-season) stays exist but are booked only Dec 1 - Feb 1, and nightly sites are sold online.
